name: Markdown Preview
description: VSCode/IDEA-style rendered Markdown preview in a side panel with real GFM tables, task lists, quotes, syntax-highlighted code cards and local images, plus heading folding and click-to-source. Refreshes while you edit; requires a plugin API v2 host.

versions.release_notes: VSCode/IDEA-style preview rendering: real tables with a tinted bold header, cell borders, zebra body rows and content-weighted columns; rounded syntax-highlighted code cards; H1/H2 rules; 14px body text at 1.6 line height; continuous quote bars; local images inside the document directory; raw HTML blocks rendered as visible text. Adjacent fenced code blocks stay separate and hard breaks no longer add paragraph gaps. Link targets are hidden by default. Structured tables and image blocks need the matching host panel features and fall back gracefully on older hosts.

Rewritten for plugin API v2; v1 hosts are no longer supported (activation requires luban.version 2). Code is split into parser, inline, renderer, highlight and text modules loaded via sandboxed require. Adds heading fold indicators with a markdown.toggle-heading command and click-to-source via markdown.goto-source, plus an on_edit parse cache so fold toggles and manual refreshes reuse the parsed block tree. Panel id, existing command ids and settings keys are unchanged, so an in-place update keeps user settings.
Fit wide tables to the 640px preview panel: columns shrink and cells truncate instead of wrapping the box drawing.

Initial release. GFM headings, emphasis, links, images, lists, task lists, quotes, fenced and indented code, tables and rules. Code blocks use the host syntax theme via luban.syntax.highlight. The preview follows edits on 1.0.0-preview.2+; older hosts render the plain-text fallback and refresh manually.

zh-CN.name: Markdown 预览
zh-CN.description: 在右侧面板按 VSCode/IDEA 风格渲染 Markdown：真实 GFM 表格、任务列表、引用、语法高亮代码卡片和文档目录内的本地图片，支持标题折叠与点击跳转源码。随编辑自动刷新；需要插件 API v2 宿主。
